title: 4 משחקי קופסא שיעזרו להם לחשוב צעד קדימה

stage.need: Making a plan and holding it in mind for a few moves, noticing what the other player is doing and changing the plan, and using earlier answers to rule things out. Harvard's 5 to 7 sheet says any strategy board game gives practice in planning several moves ahead (it names mancala) and that guessing games use working memory and flexible thinking.
stage.age_caveat: Harvard's sheet covers 5 to 7 and says children take to rule games 'with widely varying levels of interest and skill'. The slide headline says בגיל 6 with הרבה ילדים (Yarin cut בסביבות from the frame headline on 9 Oct); the caption says בסביבות גיל 6 and that some children need more time.

dev_sources.title: Executive Function Activities for 5- to 7-year-olds
dev_sources.publisher: Center on the Developing Child at Harvard University
dev_sources.quote: At this age, children start to enjoy games that have rules, but do so with widely varying levels of interest and skill. / it’s important to choose games that are demanding but not too hard for each child. / Any board game that involves some strategy provides important opportunities to make and hold a plan in mind for several moves ahead, consider the varying rules that govern different pieces, and adjust strategy in response to opponents’ moves. Through strategizing, a child’s working memory, inhibitory control, and flexibility have to work together to support plan-based, effective play. Sorry!, Battleship, Parcheesi, mancala, checkers, and Chinese checkers are some of the many examples of these types of games for children this age. / Guessing games are also popular and require players to use working memory and flexible thinking to hold in mind previous responses while they develop and discard potential theories. Some examples are 20 Questions or Guess My Rule
dev_sources.supports: Slides 1 and 2: children of 5 to 7 start to enjoy rule games (with widely varying interest and skill), and strategy board games give practice in making and holding a plan for several moves ahead and adjusting to the opponent. Mancala is named in the sheet, which backs מנקלה directly; 4 בשורה is a strategy game of the same kind (our reading, the sheet does not name it); guessing games such as 20 Questions (hold earlier answers in mind, discard theories) back נחש מי, also our reading. 'Not too hard for each child' backs the slow first rounds. Read from the PDF text (extracted locally with PDFKit) on 2026-10-10.

notes: Voice: fallback (3 of 15 samples), written after Yarin's 9 Oct edits on books.html (שיעזרו להם in the hook, בגיל X without בסביבות in the frame headline, תשאלו instead of שאלו, the close line תשמרו בשביל רעיונות, a short caption with no product list). Ranking source: Toys R Us Israel board-games collection, sort 'הנמכרים ביותר', pages 1 to 3 (120 products) downloaded and parsed on 2026-10-10 at about 14:53 IDT; header count 464. Ranks read: 4 בשורה 12, מנקלה 16, נחש מי לנשיאה על הדרך 19, נחש מי 2024 44. Rejected: משוך בגזר 5, עץ הקופים 29, קוד הצבע 22, סלמון שמח 23, מצא את 7 ההבדלים 37 (30-day cooldown); חלומות 17 and ג'ונגל ספיד 18 (older official ages, Fox Mind); נחשים וסולמות 35 and 36 (luck, not planning). All three picks are Kodkod, a maker used in the last 14 days and three times here (validator warnings): they were the only strategy or deduction games for age 6 inside the top 10 percent outside the cooldown. Stage 6 to 7 moves away from last night's 5 to 6. The Toys R Us product photos for 4 בשורה and מנקלה are 410 and 390 px, so the pictures come from Kodkod's own pages. Rewritten on 10 Oct 2026 22:50 under Hook Studio (same stage, products and Israeli evidence, all read on 10 Oct): a scene ending in the hook (Harvard EF 5 to 7: a strategy game gives practice in planning several moves ahead), highlights on slides 1, 2 and the close, three hook wordings in hook_alternatives, and the LumeBook picture is the catalogue cover whose idea the line states, drawn as a 3D book.
